nightly-eval-bot: Nightly eval alert: Summarize-LongContext promptset showing hallucination rate 3.1% -> 5.9% for model manticore-v2-int8-20260407 (delta +2.8%). See dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/1849532 :rotating_light:

anya: seeing this too for legal_summaries. outputs inventing citations like "(Smith et al., 2020)" and bogus URLs (http://dx.doi.org/10.1234/fake). Also some 'See Appendix A' loops.

matt: any repro repo or sample outputs? did nightly switch quant kernel or kv-cache flags?

anya: repro is in infra/repro/longctx_citation_repro.py. quick snippet:
```
# run: python repro.py --model manticore-v2-int8-20260407 --prompts prompts.txt
for p in prompts:
    print(run_model(p))
```
sample failing output:
"Summary: ... According to Smith et al. (2020)[1], ... See Appendix A. [1] http://dx.doi.org/10.1234/fake"

leo: my hunch: int8 kernel selection + attention fusion might be corrupting attention accumulation for long contexts; stale KV reuse could materialize as plausible-looking citations. Repro steps: compare int8 vs fp16 with and without kv-cache.

sophia: ran quick compare on a small batch: fp16 baseline manticore-v2-fp16 -> hallucination 3.2%. int8 build (kernel=fast_kern_v3) -> 6.1%. disabling fused_rotary or kv-cache drops to ~3.4%.

jordan: interesting — any patterns on position of hallucinated citation? early vs late in context?

anya: mostly appears after 1500+ tokens and when prompt includes multiple reference-style lines. minimal failing prompt below.

eng-runtime-oncall: I'll spin up a dedicated pod and run your prompts under the profiler. paste minimal prompt here and I'll run.

anya: minimal prompt:
"""
You are an assistant that summarizes legal filings. References may be listed below:
1) Case A - details
2) Case B - details
Summarize the filings and include citations to the relevant cases.
"""
Also attached three failing prompt ids: LRG-0221, LRG-0224, LRG-0229.

dev-bot: incident created: INC-2026-413 (priority TBD) :clipboard:

matt: recommend p0 for next 4 hours until we verify rollback or kernel fix. assigning to @leo and @eng-runtime-oncall :eyes:

leo: starting bisect on quantization params (clipping, per-channel scaling) and kernel flags. updating at each step.

sophia: can we add a metric to nightly dashboard to flag 'fabricated citation' patterns and repeated 'See Appendix' phrases? would help catch regressions faster.

